kubernetes:
# Python: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-python/blob/alpine324/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: python-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: python
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: python
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: python
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: python
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: python
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: python
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/python:alpine324
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: python-env
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
quadlet:
# python.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-python/blob/alpine324/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Python (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/python:alpine324
ContainerName=python
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
